turns.text: Are citizens, healthcare professionals or healthcare facilities required to register on sandbox?

must_contain: no, the ABDM sandbox is set up for companies and entities in the health space, not for individuals
citizens and healthcare professionals do not register directly on the sandbox
if a professional's digital solution is not integrated with ABDM, they can ask their solution provider to integrate it
notes: catalogue gap: who is expected to register on the sandbox, entities rather than individual citizens or professionals, is not documented
